import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static Map<Integer, Long> tab1 = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<String, Long> tab2 = new HashMap<>();

    public static long num1(int n) {
        if (n < 0)
            return 0;
        if (n < 2)
            return 1;
        if (!tab1.containsKey(n)) {
            long r = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                r += num1(i) * num1(n - 1 - i);
            }
            tab1.put(n, r);
        }
        return tab1.get(n);
    }

    public static long num2(int n, int h) {
        if (n < 0 || h <= 0 || n >= Math.pow(2, h - 1))
            return 0;
        if (n < 2)
            return 1;
        if (n < h)
            return num1(n);
        String key = n + "," + h;
        if (!tab2.containsKey(key)) {
            long r = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                r += num2(i, h - 1) * num2(n - 1 - i, h - 1);
            }
            tab2.put(key, r);
        }
        return tab2.get(key);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int h = scanner.nextInt();
        System.out.println(num1(n) - num2(n, h));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
